definitions.explanation: The system that provides water to buildings, or the water from it.
The fixture from which water flows.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}の{水|みず}は{飲|の}めます。
examples.english: You can drink the tap water.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}を{止|と}めてください。
{水道代|すいどうだい}が{高|たか}くなりました。
examples.english: The water bill has gone up.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{水道|すいどう}が{止|と}まってしまいました。
examples.english: The water supply was cut off due to the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {水道|すいどう}から{水|みず}が{出|で}ないので、{修理|しゅうり}を{頼|たの}みました。
examples.english: No water was coming out of the tap, so I called for repairs.

notes: 水道 combines 水 (water) and 道 (way/path). Japan is known for having safe, drinkable tap water. 水道代 is the water utility bill. 水道水 (すいどうすい) specifically means tap water.
